description: Source code for the PieChartRenderer class in the PDFsharp library, responsible for rendering pie charts in PDF documents.

classes.name: PieChartRenderer
classes.description: A class that handles rendering of pie charts within the PDFsharp charting module.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes renderer-specific information for the pie chart.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Calculates layout and space for the pie chart.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Draws the pie chart, including legend, walls, plot area, and data labels.

methods.name: GetPlotAreaRenderer
methods.description: Returns the specific plot area renderer based on chart type.

methods.name: InitSeries
methods.description: Initializes data necessary to draw each series in the pie chart.
